notes: Only explicit benign training labels may fit a normal reference; only explicit benign validation labels may calibrate it.
Test labels and test values must not select models, fit transforms, or choose alert thresholds.
Unknown/background label -1 is not benign and is excluded from attack-classification metrics.
Record-level attack labels are not individual-KPI anomaly truth.
All rows and original train/validation/test assignments are retained, including repeated numeric observations.
No source timestamp is available. The time column is source-row position for display only, not elapsed or chronological time.
Original splits group full numeric feature patterns by hash; no temporal or new-device generalization claim is supported.
Each network protocol has its own normal reference and calibration: TCP, UDP, ICMP, and unknown_transport are never pooled.
Sparse/unknown protocol contexts may be not applicable; no fallback borrows a reference from other protocols.
Raw protocol and service fields are retained as descriptive metadata, not numeric distances.
Three binary flags are omitted from continuous-KPI 3-sigma/IQR modelling; binary state transitions are not continuous magnitude anomalies.
interpretation: Retrospective calibrated exploration; calibration fraction is not independent performance or a guaranteed future false-positive rate.

input_imputation.rule: fit-reference mode for CQI/RI/pcmax; median for other KPIs; per-context
input_imputation.no_fit_observations: leave missing and unscored; do not borrow calibration/test values
input_imputation.qualification: Predictions on imputed values are model outputs for estimates, not measured KPI health.

reasons.duration: 连接或流持续时间是核心流行为指标；不将其误称为单包端到端时延。
reasons.src_bytes: 源方向字节量描述一个流的业务规模。
reasons.dst_bytes: 目的方向字节量描述反方向业务规模，保留方向差异。
reasons.src_pkts: 源方向报文数反映流的报文负载。
reasons.dst_pkts: 目的方向报文数反映反方向负载及响应规模。

excluded_reasons.missed_bytes: 原拟合参考为常量，缺乏训练参考变化，不列入核心性能集合。
excluded_reasons.src_ip_bytes: 与已选源方向字节量部分重复，避免同一流量规模被多个近似指标重复计入OR。
excluded_reasons.dst_ip_bytes: 与已选目的方向字节量部分重复，避免同一流量规模被多个近似指标重复计入OR。
excluded_reasons.http_trans_depth: HTTP事务深度具有应用协议专属性，不是跨TCP/UDP/ICMP共同性能KPI。
excluded_reasons.files_total_bytes: 文件传输字节量具有应用场景专属性，核心流量规模由方向字节量表示。

selected_feature_policy.source_metadata_quality_fields: preserved source-level annotations; not selected-KPI missingness denominators

record_rule: No record-level predictions are reused here. Run summarize_by_label separately for within-method any-applicable-KPI OR with undetermined records retained.
label_interpretation: Dataset attack/benign labels are not per-KPI health truth; unknown and unlabelled records remain separate.
